title: Andrew Berry on QBs: We'll let it play out, figure it out as we go

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Andrew Berry on QBs: We'll let it play out, figure it out as we go
sources.description: The Browns are alternating Shedeur Sanders and Deshaun Watson at quarterback with the first-team offense to start training camp, which is largely the same process as the team employed during the offseason program.
